limitations.closure_criteria: A separately versioned federation extension defines topology, delegation and coordination without weakening Seed invariants.
limitations.description: Seed permits an explicit next Resolution Authority but does not define local, federal or metafederal topology, discovery or consensus.

limitations.closure_criteria: Monade and evidence extensions define those behaviours and conform to the active Seed package.
limitations.description: Seed resolves normative questions; it does not execute work, acquire evidence or retain negative attempts.

limitations.closure_criteria: Each implementation profile publishes independent operational evidence.
limitations.description: Storage, durability, concurrency, recovery and availability guarantees are not selected by Seed.

limitations.closure_criteria: Complete an independently reviewed unbounded refinement or state the accepted assurance level for 1.0.
limitations.description: The decision lattice and escalation chain are bounded-model checked, but unbounded refinement is not claimed.

limitations.closure_criteria: Publish an external audit tied to commit and package digest.
limitations.description: No independent third-party audit is bound to the exact 0.2 alpha package.

limitations.closure_criteria: Migration profiles explicitly map predecessor concepts into extensions and implementations update conformance claims.
limitations.description: Seed 0.2 deliberately narrows the active canon and is not wire- or semantic-compatible with the rc11/rc12 lifecycle model.
